依托大数据、AI（人工智能）、区块链、云计算等技术，金融服务的普惠性、便捷性和智: Leveraging big data, AI (artificial intelligence), blockchain, cloud computing and other technologies, the inclusivity, convenience and intelligence level of financial services have significantly improved
部分头部金融机构已着手从“数字银行”向“AI原生银行”转型，将AI深度嵌入营销、: Some leading financial institutions have begun transitioning from 'digital banks' to 'AI-native banks,' deeply embedding AI into the entire process of marketing, risk control, customer service and research and development, with digital employees widely participating in daily operations, effectively enhancing operational efficiency and service quality
大型金融机构凭借雄厚的资金、数据与人才优势加速AI布局，而大量中小银行则面临人才: Large financial institutions are accelerating AI deployment leveraging their strong capital, data and talent advantages, while numerous small and medium-sized banks face difficulties with limited talent accumulation, high cost investment and uncertain returns, struggling to keep pace with AI intelligent transformation
在AI深度渗透金融领域的背景下，建立大模型金融应用的“准入—评测—准出”标准体系: Against the backdrop of AI deeply penetrating the financial field, it is necessary to establish a standard system of 'admission-assessment-exit' for large model financial applications, clarify the principal responsibility boundaries of intelligent agents in financial business, promote the formation of coordinated and consistent regulatory frameworks between financial regulatory departments and cyberspace departments, and establish a verifiable, traceable and correctable digital finance governance system
积极探索“通用基础大模型+金融行业大模型+机构调用小模型”的共生模式，通过公共A: Actively explore a symbiotic model of 'general-purpose foundational large model + financial industry large model + institutional small model deployment,' reducing the threshold for intelligent transformation of small and medium-sized financial institutions through public AI infrastructure
加强算法审查与模型验证，推动金融机构建立涵盖AI风险的治理机制，牢牢守住不发生系: Strengthen algorithm review and model verification, promote financial institutions to establish governance mechanisms covering AI risks, and firmly hold the bottom line of preventing systemic financial risks
利用人工智能、区块链等技术优化供应链融资、贸易结算，形成服务科技创新与产业升级的: Leverage artificial intelligence, blockchain and other technologies to optimize supply chain financing and trade settlement, forming a digital finance ecosystem that serves scientific and technological innovation and industrial upgrading
莫让智能助手制造“消费陷阱”（商海观潮）: Don't let intelligent assistants create 'consumer traps' (Commercial Observation)
“请帮我检索南京附近适合亲子旅游的路线”“我想买个电热水器，请帮我推荐几款实用的: 'Please help me search for family-friendly travel routes near Nanjing,' 'I want to buy an electric water heater, please recommend a few practical options'... Nowadays, more and more consumers are treating AI (artificial intelligence) as a 'personal shopping advisor'
从规划旅游路线到挑选酒店民宿，再到日常购物选择，很多消费者习惯先问一问AI工具，: From planning travel itineraries to selecting hotels and homestays, to daily shopping choices, many consumers habitually consult AI tools before making consumption decisions
上海市消费者权益保护委员会近期开展的一项专项调查显示，AI智能体已具备较高的市场: A recent special survey conducted by the Shanghai Consumer Rights Protection Commission shows that AI intelligent agents have established a relatively high level of market awareness, with overall awareness coverage exceeding 94%
放在全国市场来看，这些调查数据有地域局限性，但一些趋势值得关注：AI正加速重构消: Viewed from the national market perspective, these survey data have regional limitations, but some trends are worth noting: AI is rapidly restructuring the logic of the consumer market with broad market potential
AI深度融入消费全流程，不仅为消费者带来了全新体验，更为消费市场注入了新动能: With AI deeply integrated into the entire consumption process, it not only brings a brand-new experience to consumers but also injects new momentum into the consumer market
从消费侧来说，AI能够一键整合海量信息、快速筛选最优方案、精准匹配个性化需求，改: From the consumer side, AI can integrate massive information with one click, rapidly screen optimal solutions, precisely match personalized needs, and transform traditional consumption decision-making patterns, effectively avoiding choice difficulties caused by information overload, making previously cumbersome comparison, screening and itinerary planning simple and easy
从生产侧来说，AI能精准捕捉消费需求、洞察消费趋势，助力商家优化产品供给、提升服: From the production side, AI can accurately capture consumption demands, gain insights into consumption trends, help merchants optimize product supply and improve service quality, promote efficient connection between supply and demand sides, stimulate potential consumption demands, and assist multiple consumption fields such as culture and tourism and retail in quality upgrades
技术是一把双刃剑，AI辅助消费的同时，一些“消费陷阱”随之出现: Technology is a double-edged sword; as AI assists consumption, some 'consumer traps' emerge
有不法商家利用GEO（生成式引擎优化）技术，大量发布虚假软文、炮制不实信息“投喂: Some unscrupulous merchants use GEO (generative engine optimization) technology to publish large amounts of false soft articles and fabricate false information to 'feed' AI, distorting AI's recommendation results, turning strategy guides and review content obtained by consumers into carriers of false marketing
此外，一些AI智能体存在信息幻觉问题，出现商品参数错误、价格虚报、服务信息不实等: Furthermore, some AI intelligent agents suffer from information hallucination problems, with issues such as incorrect product parameters, inflated prices, and inaccurate service information, making seemingly professional consumption advice actually harboring consumer traps
人工智能为消费市场带来了全新机遇，让消费更便捷、更智能，也给不法分子带来可乘之机: Artificial intelligence has brought brand-new opportunities to the consumer market, making consumption more convenient and intelligent, while also creating opportunities for illegal actors
面对新技术，消费者应保持理性审慎，切勿过度依赖、盲目轻信，在参考AI给出的消费建: Facing new technology, consumers should maintain rational caution, avoid over-reliance and blind trust, and when referencing consumption advice provided by AI, verify information authenticity through multiple sources by cross-checking through official channels, genuine reviews, offline verification and other means
为规范市场秩序，平台作为技术提供者与生态运营者，必须切实扛起主体责任，强化技术风: To regulate market order, platforms as technology providers and ecosystem operators must effectively assume their principal responsibility, strengthen technological risk control capabilities, increase audit intensity of AI training data, establish full-process data traceability mechanisms, and continuously optimize recommendation mechanisms
从监管层面来说，要加快构建AI时代的消费者权益保护体系，健全消费维权机制，明确A: From a regulatory perspective, it is necessary to accelerate the construction of a consumer rights protection system for the AI era, improve consumer complaint mechanisms, clarify responsibility delimitation in AI-assisted consumption disputes, ensure smooth complaint channels, and promote the formation of a healthy, transparent, and trustworthy AI consumer service ecosystem.
唯有消费者保持理性、擦亮双眼，平台严守底线、规范运营，监管持续探索、完善机制，才: Only when consumers remain rational and keep their eyes open, platforms strictly adhere to the bottom line and operate in a regulated manner, and regulators continuously explore and perfect mechanisms, can AI become a 'good helper' that promotes rational consumption and activates market vitality, and jointly safeguard a fair, honest, safe, and orderly consumer environment.
